create_descriptor_pool: create a DescriptorPool to manage protocol buffer file descriptors and message types dynamically
find_message_type_by_name: find a message type descriptor by its fully qualified name in the DescriptorPool
add_serialized_file: add a serialized FileDescriptorProto to the DescriptorPool for dynamic message registration
find_extension_by_number: find an extension field descriptor by its field number for a given message type
test_descriptor_pool: test the DescriptorPool by verifying file, message, enum, and extension lookups work correctly
